title: Q-LESSON-PATCH-GATE: Agent patches pass node --check and their tests before merge
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/worker-gate.js::node --check
**Status:** closed

LESSONS-1 (2026-11-16): from the failure-mode register of the fleet this org was split from (638 entries, classified by root cause).

93 failure modes came from a code loop that edited very large files through search-and-replace windows and was checked for syntax only (invented anchors, corrupt splices, calls to undefined helpers).

Path: seed/worker/src/worker-gate.js

Acceptance: worker-gate.js passes an agent branch only when every changed .js file passes node --check, the tests next to it pass, and no file over 60 KB is edited by a model; test/worker-gate.test.mjs covers each refusal.

size: S

**Closing probe:** grep:seed/worker/src/worker-gate.js::node --check

**Evidence:** worker-gate.js checkModelEdits refuses a model branch (agent/ or claude/) when a changed file is over 60 KB before or after the edit (MAX_MODEL_EDIT_BYTES), when a changed .js/.mjs/.cjs file fails the syntax check, or when its content is unreadable. In the Worker the check is jsShapeCheck (strings, templates, comments, regex, bracket balance), because node --check needs a child process; the limit is documented in the code and the `syntax` option takes a node --check runner where Node exists. Tests: seed/worker/test/worker-gate.test.js (each refusal, plus node --check catching what the scanner cannot). Follow-up: running the tests next to a changed file needs a Node runtime and stays with `checks` / `python3 -m foundation checksrun`; it is not enforced by the Worker gate.
